'''IP-CPT''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as [[the Unmasked]] to guard their [[Unmasked research station|research station]] in [[Sector R-4]]. It was created by [[Dominique|Lady Dominique]] with the assistance of [[ARIA (AI)|ARIA]], an [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]]. It was destroyed by the [[Alliance Commander]] during the [[mission to the R-4 anomaly]] and it's remains were likely destroyed when the station exploded.<ref name="operation" />
